title: OSA-ED donor-aware public-omics reproducibility archive
description: Versioned analysis and figure-generation scripts, panel-level derived figure source-data tables, and frozen SHA-256 input manifests for a public-data, donor-aware, cross-dataset OSA-ED hypothesis-prioritization analysis. This archive does not establish causality, diagnostic performance, therapeutic targets, experimental validation, or a biological mechanism.
